name: Area 51 but find coils to survive
desc:
Welcome to A51BFCTS, a game that is not suppose to be taken seriously.

—————————————————————Gameplay——————————————————————
The gameplay contain items that give special effects and abilities:

Coils - Coils give out effects like speedboost, jumpboost, regenerationboost to the player holding it, and some coils have special abilities like infinitejump or even timestop.

Wands - A wand is a type of attack/defense item that fling any entity. They can also have special abilities.

Leftovers - Leftovers are items that cure boredom by doing something idk. Leftovers can be found in the lobby and on the surface, the VIP leftovers can only be found on the surface.

———————————————————General Information——————————————————
Current version: v5.2 🎃
